description: Per-stage required assertions for the single-cell RNA-seq taxonomy, carried by the single_cell_de archetype. Stage keys match the archetype's task ids (the harness matches on task_id when spec.stage_class is absent); required-artifact filenames match the single_cell_de atoms' declared required_artifacts, so a free-choice agent that fulfils its task spec passes. Goal-agnostic: required assertions check only that each stage produced its declared output (recursive `**` glob, so flat OR compartment-partitioned layouts both match). Study-specific clinical covariates carried over from the original IVD derivation (a disease-grade column, a tissue-compartment column, an age column, a study column) were REMOVED from the required metadata-column check — they would false-fail a general single-cell study (tumour/immune atlas); only a sample-level join key is required. Stages absent from a given DAG self-gate (the harness only enforces a stage_class that has a matching completed task).

assertions.description: A dataset_registry.tsv listing every accession with kept/dropped status is recommended.
sample_metadata.tsv must be produced when a metadata_harmonization stage runs.

Harmonized metadata must carry a sample-level join key so cells can be tied to samples downstream. Goal-agnostic: any of the common key names satisfies it. Study-specific clinical covariates (e.g. age, disease grade, tissue compartment) are NOT required here — those belong to a scenario overlay, not the general single-cell contract.
Doublet detection (Scrublet/DoubletFinder or equivalent) is recommended; recorded in the manifest.
integration_stats.json must be produced when batch_correction runs (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob: flat or compartment-partitioned layouts both match.
A batch-mixing metric (iLISI or equivalent) in integration_stats.json is recommended.
cluster_assignments.tsv(.gz) must be produced (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
A clustering-resolution sweep recorded in the manifest is recommended.
celltype_assignments.tsv(.gz) must be produced with a cell-type column (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
de_results.tsv(.gz) must carry more than its header row — an empty DE table marks the stage as not actually run. Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
The DE design string in the manifest should record the condition/grouping covariate at minimum.
An enrichment/pathway table must be produced (ORA, GSEA, or method-consensus). Recursive glob over any .tsv handles the atom's pathway_results.tsv and partitioned layouts.
Pseudotime assignments (dpt_per_cell.tsv.gz or equivalent) when the stage runs (recommended).
An interaction table must be produced when the stage runs (LIANA or CellChat). Recursive glob over any .tsv handles flat or partitioned layouts.
A final report must be produced (HTML or Markdown acceptable).
